topics.description: The investigation into Jerome Powell has sparked concerns about the independence of the Federal Reserve. Former Fed chairs have condemned the investigation, and Yellen has stated that it is 'extremely chilling' for the market.
topics.reason: Criminal investigation into Federal Reserve Chairman
